question: Should the stable config schema begin with only built-in global/per-account MCP profiles, or commit now to custom named profiles and per-tool override maps?
rationale: Current main does not implement the feature, and VISION.md requires discussion for new persistent/API surfaces; schema breadth and whether config acts as a default or restriction ceiling are durable product-contract choices.

options.title: Start minimal
options.body: Add built-in global and per-account profiles through one resolver, deferring custom profiles and per-tool config maps.

options.title: Adopt full schema
options.body: Accept custom named profiles, per-tool booleans, and account overrides as a stable configuration contract.

options.title: Retain flags
options.body: Keep MCP exposure entirely in client command-line arguments and add no persistent policy schema.

recommendation.title: Start minimal
recommendation.body: Add built-in global and per-account profiles through one resolver, deferring custom profiles and per-tool config maps.

likelyOwner.reason: The release and current-main history make him the strongest available owner for deciding the durable repository configuration contract.
